title: Don't Get Caught In This Market Bull Trap!?
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: NFP +29k vs 90k and unemployment 4.2% cut Fed hike odds from 75% to ~19.5%; bad news is good news, but this can flip fast with CPI and more data.
Toshiba ramping 2027 supply raises oversupply fears for memory names (WDC -12%, STX, SNDK).
Middle East escalation means oil and diesel prices still expected to go higher.

calls.reason: Nasdaq +1.5% on weak-jobs/Fed relief, but sees early signs of a possible pullback and warns the rally can reverse with CPI.
calls.quote: It looks like we're seeing early stages of a possible pullback, but this is far from an actual, you know, going into the red.

calls.reason: Shorted Micron intraday as memory names sold off on Toshiba supply news; notes MU 'fully selling off'.
calls.quote: We could see now Micron is actually fully selling off.

calls.reason: Middle East escalation keeps oil and diesel prices headed higher.
calls.quote: with all the escalations that we've seen over the week in the Middle East, oil prices, diesel prices, we're still expected to go higher.

notes: Date: NFP Friday ('happy Friday'), consistent with 2026-10-02. MU short was an intraday trade. WDC/STX/SNDK moves reported as news only, not recorded.
